items.summary: The Clarity Act has a narrowing window to pass. Senate Democrats remain committed to passing the crypto bill as SEC, CFTC push rules.

items.title: Stock Market Today: Nasdaq Snaps Losing Streak; Nvidia Gains As This Stock Soars On Amazon Deal
items.summary: Stocks rebounded with the Nasdaq and S&P 500 jumping back above key support. Generac, Nebius, Bloom Energy, SpaceX were early winners.
